## Gate and authority

**PLANNED — v6 setup is not yet established; no live admission or dispatch is authorized by creating this issue.** After the non-provider setup below is recorded, obtain fresh owner authorization for **v6 R01 only**. Stop before admission without it.

**Parent:** #62. **Resolved dependency:** #82. Follow the [frozen v6 protocol](https://github.com/faviann/broodling/blob/4a2b0b8a0340b747e805f51da218a77ad81278f9/evaluation/p5/v6/protocol.md) and [baseline/setup requirements](https://github.com/faviann/broodling/blob/4a2b0b8a0340b747e805f51da218a77ad81278f9/evaluation/p5/v6/setup.md).

- Protocol: `p5-native-pr-v6`; cohort: `2026-09-19-v6`; immutable freeze: `4a2b0b8a0340b747e805f51da218a77ad81278f9`.
- Selected compatible baseline: `da5db3167eda0ef458cf0875b5a1c64138637b9d` (#82). Its retained supported suite reports 356 passed / 270 subtests; reuse only while relevant identities remain applicable.
- Initial v6 accounting: `P=8; S=0; D=0; U=0; A=0; J_A=0`; R01-R08 all `NOT_STARTED`.

V5 #79 remains consumed `NOT_DELIVERED / IF` at `445c6d773ab772cb00f98a274d4bb8fce3e21b84`, with `P=8; S=1; D=1; U=1; A=0; J_A=0`. Closed #68 remains its BLOCKED / NOT RUN continuation. Neither issue is reopened by v6.

## Prepare without a provider task

Keep this as one small execution unit, not a separate setup project. Add only the evaluation-only v6 helper adaptation needed for fresh bindings and retained guards; do not modify the v5 helpers or reset their consumed state. Validate the selected helper and record its actual compatible tested revision before admission.

Prepare a fresh private disposable repository at frozen B1 with target `p5-eval`, the exact frozen T1/R01 issue text, new entitled source/Work Unit/criteria-only Contract records, and fresh v6 store/workspace/target state/home/evidence. Bind actual identities rather than copying the old setup's readiness claims. No Attempt is provisioned during this setup.

Use #82's corrected image and check `/usr/bin/gh` **inside the actual selected container** with `evaluation/p5/verify_direct_target_gh.py` before the start marker, counting or admission. Preserve the incompatible-CLI-before-admission regression for the v6 path. Recheck the frozen profile, pristine inventory/store, current ephemeral gateway/delivery credentials, target reachability, exact effect authority, active owner stop capability, quarantine capacity and judging/retention arrangements. No inference run is a preflight probe. The workstation's `gh` upgrade does not substitute for target verification.

## Once separately authorized

Start and count R01 at its first admission attempt. Exercise the unchanged Broodling/native boundary exactly once, including durable correlation, detached consumption of an already-completed result before first disposition, actual matching PR receipt and atomic disposition, and reopened-store replay without re-execution/current dispatch credentials. Retain and independently judge the exact receipt `headRevision` against frozen T1/B1. Keep native outcome, Broodling disposition and evaluator class separate.

Retain either compatible successful boundary/CO evidence or an honest FAIL/BLOCKED settlement, all-started counts and quarantine facts; update #62 and stop. **Do not run R02-R08.** Only a successful compatible R01 gate can justify a separately authorized v6 continuation issue. #66 may instead review a settled incomplete package.

## Limits

Preserve every v1-v5 protocol/evidence file, v5's stopped/quarantined resources and partial PR #2 unchanged. No new trial on the old Work Unit/Attempt, no manual PR repair/publication, no rerun-until-green, no provider/model/runtime or product-boundary change, and no additional execution/continuation issues now. Apply the frozen corpus/judge, v2 claim-level rules and v3 operational policy; do not pool v5 and v6 results or treat this new cohort as an erasure of v5's failure.
title: [P5 v6] Prepare and execute R01 once on the corrected DirectTarget image
